# Matt Motherway

> Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 15+ years' experience building scalable, secure, high-performance applications. Proficient in TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

Matt Motherway is a software engineer and consultant based in Reno, NV. He specializes in full-stack web development with a focus on financial software, ERP systems, and developer tooling.
